location: Verbatim: 'The Chop House seating area is located in right field at Truist Park, near: Sections 156–160, Section 257, Section 259.' 'Social Seating in Right Field: Located near Sections 156–160, 257 and 259.'
seat_direction: When looking towards the stage/field, lower number seats are on the right
notes: 'Premium seating area as part of the Chop House Club.' Views 'focus primarily on the right field and outfield portions of the game' and are 'not as direct as seats near the dugomes' (near the dugouts); Home Run Territory: 'Located near the right field wall where fans have a chance at a homerun ball.' High-top bar-style seating with cupholders is typical of the Chop House area generally. ANOMALY: the Chop House Club zone review names three specific seating styles — Chop House Terrace (Sections 156-160, 5 rows), Chop House Deck (Section 259, single row of ~20 seats), and Below the Chop (unnumbered) — but does not say which style Section 257 belongs to, and 257's own 'Rows in Section 257 are labeled 1-2' does not match any of the three described styles cleanly.
